name: Your First Hour with ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini
description: A hands-on hour with ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini, told through one small business racing a deadline. Set up an account with a privacy setting you chose, decide what never goes into a personal account, write prompts that produce usable drafts, use files and web search, catch confident mistakes before they go out, and pick the assistant that fits how you work.

image.caption: Wirewalk Institute of AI badge: Your First Hour with ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini

criteria.narrative:
To earn this certificate a learner must: complete all 7 lessons in 3 modules, play each of the course's 3 Decision Labs to an ending (the lab score does not count); and pass the final exam: 10 questions, 20 minutes, pass mark 80%, at most 3 attempts, with a 24-hour wait after a failed attempt.

The exam is taken online and is not proctored. The holder's identity is not verified; the name is the one on their account. This is a certificate of completion and assessment issued by Wirewalk Institute of AI. It is not an accreditation, academic credit, license, or a certification from any vendor. Details: https://institute.wirewalk.com/certification/#limits

alignment.targetName: Decide whether an everyday task suits an AI chat assistant and predict the failure most likely to affect it: missing context, invented details, outdated facts or a misread file
alignment.targetFramework: Wirewalk Institute of AI course outcomes

alignment.targetName: Set up a free ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini account with the model-training control set on purpose, and sort information into what is fine in a personal account, what belongs only in an employer's approved tool and what goes nowhere, keeping customer, patient, client and employee data out of personal accounts
alignment.targetFramework: Wirewalk Institute of AI course outcomes

alignment.targetName: Write a prompt that states goal, context and format and forbids invented details, then improve the result with specific follow-ups until it is usable
alignment.targetFramework: Wirewalk Institute of AI course outcomes

alignment.targetName: Use file uploads and web search where they fit, asking for the supporting quote from a file and opening the sources behind any fact that changes over time
alignment.targetFramework: Wirewalk Institute of AI course outcomes

alignment.targetName: Identify the checkable claims in an AI draft and verify them against primary sources, with effort matched to the stakes, before the draft is sent
alignment.targetFramework: Wirewalk Institute of AI course outcomes

alignment.targetName: Choose an assistant and plan for a person and task using a scored side-by-side test and the tiebreakers that matter: whose terms cover the data, the tool already licensed and budget, and say what a paid plan would and would not change
alignment.targetFramework: Wirewalk Institute of AI course outcomes
